question: Does attention11's literal subject-value weight contraction compile the direct L8H1-written subject state into the complete H3-Q8 coordinates consumed by the final weight reader?

authority.source_status: On the earlier fresh bank, subject-onset terms exactly equal all query-source H3 response and every non-subject group is zero.
authority.l9_status: The L9 triple explains only 14.46%/15.96% of live H3-Q8 norm on v10, while its small value-weight branch is predictable.

frozen_design.population: All 31 A1 and 32 A2 jointly capable sealed v10 rows.
frozen_design.causal_contrast: Compare native base with the exact live L8H1 cue-to-subject writer and measure the complete answer-query H3-Q8 response.
frozen_design.weight_writer: Contract only the two subject-onset normalized-state changes through H3's attention11.c_v weight rows, the exact (1-lamb) current-value factor, the native-base H3 attention pattern, and Q8. Preserve pattern and interaction terms as explicit residuals.
frozen_design.behavioral_contraction: Contract the predicted eight coordinates with the released analytic final reader and compare against exact finite resid18 actuation of the complete live H3-Q8 response.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_capture_weight_co: Hashes, capture identities, attention reconstruction, value-weight reconstruction, finite complete coverage, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_subject_value_weights_explain_h3_: The base-pattern subject-value term predicts complete live H3-Q8 coordinates with cosine at least 0.95 and relative RMSE at most 0.20 in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_nonvalue_and_nonsubject_terms_are: The residual after the subject-value term has mean norm at most 20% of complete H3-Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_composed_margin_prediction_is_acc: Predicted coordinates contracted with the analytic final reader predict exact finite complete-H3-Q8 margin effects with cosine at least 0.95 and relative RMSE at most 0.25 in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_direct_route_dominates_l9_branch: Complete live H3-Q8 mean norm is at least four times the previously measured L9-triple-mediated norm in both panels.

decision: All predicates close the main upstream-to-downstream tensor path L8H1 subject write -> attention11 H3 value weights -> Q8 -> H3 output weights -> residual skip -> final analytic reader. Failure of subject-value prediction redirects to pattern computation; failure of dominance reopens serial topology.
